title: Sequence
description: An ordered list of modules: a meeting (content/sequences/<id>.json). PLAN.md section 6.3. The sequence builder (Phase 2) exports files in this shape.

totalMinutes.description: Target meeting length. The check warns if the steps don't add up to it.

optional.description: Hidden when the leader turns on Short on time.

author.description: A leader's name or initials. Never a boy's name.
